productionBugFix.description: Route config format was wrong — SDK expects { accepts: { scheme, price, network, payTo } } but code was passing { price, network, payTo } directly. This caused TypeError during validateRouteConfiguration in ALL environments (not just tests). The middleware would always fail to initialize and fall back to graceful degradation, meaning NO payment enforcement was ever active.
productionBugFix.fix: Updated buildRouteConfig() to wrap payment options in `accepts` field with `scheme: 'exact'`.
productionBugFix.impact: This was a production bug — x402 payment middleware was non-functional. All paid endpoints were either passing through without payment (dev) or returning 503 (production).
